_note: Effectiveness multiplier applied to a spell of the given school vs an enemy of the given family. INVARIANT I-2: hard floor 0.8 (impaired, never blocked). 1.0 neutral, 1.2 advantage, 1.5 major weakness, 2.0 signature weakness. selfElementRule: if spell.school == enemy.selfElement, override to 0.8.

lore.PYROMANCY: Fire sears plant (Verdant x2) and scorches flesh/undead; damp holy flame is resisted by Radiant; constructs shrug it off.
lore.CRYOMANCY: Ice slows living things and jams mechanisms; brittle to the already-dead and the radiant.
lore.ELECTROMANCY: Shock disrupts clockwork (x2) and nerve (flesh/beast); ground out by plant/earth (0.8).
lore.NATURE: Roots/decay strangle the living and undead but cannot grip inert stone/metal or holy light.
lore.HOLY: Radiance devastates undead (x2) and severs void (x1.5); resisted by its own kind (Radiant) and the corruption-touched.
lore.SHADOW: Darkness corrodes oaths and radiant constructs (x1.5); passes harmlessly through the already-shadow (Void) and the dead (Undead, 0.8).
lore.PHYSICAL: Steel cuts flesh and dents metal; passes through amorphous Void (0.8); blunts on Verdant bark.
